## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive; Consumer Staples, Consumer Discretionary, Healthcare, Materials, Energy and Communication are positive while Technology, Financials, Industrials, Real Estate and Utilities lag. Leadership: Broad (Top 5 span 5 sectors), supporting a mixed, non-directional market.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Consumer Staples lead: MNST (1W: +6.95% | 1M: +4.67%) ABOVE TREND and WMT (1W: +4.97% | 1M: +11.22%) ABOVE TREND. Consumer Discretionary strong: HD (1W: +6.63% | 1M: +3.30%) ABOVE TREND and SBUX (1W: +6.05% | 1M: +2.13%) ABOVE TREND. Healthcare constructive: UNH (1W: +7.49% | 1M: +7.95%) ABOVE TREND and LLY (1W: +4.88% | 1M: +7.58%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Technology is lagging: NVDA (1W: -4.08% | 1M: -2.33%) BELOW TREND and INTC (1W: -9.20% | 1M: -15.26%) BELOW TREND. Financials mixed-to-weak: SCHW (1W: -7.71% | 1M: -14.89%) BELOW TREND and C (1W: -7.75% | 1M: -7.65%) BELOW TREND. Industrials showing weakness: CAT (1W: -9.20% | 1M: -10.28%) BELOW TREND and ETN (1W: -8.25% | 1M: -7.83%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: ACN (1W: +11.15% | 1M: +31.74%) ABOVE TREND; UNH (1W: +7.49% | 1M: +7.95%) ABOVE TREND; LMT (1W: +7.10% | 1M: +2.78%) ABOVE TREND; DOW (1W: +6.97% | 1M: +4.70%) ABOVE TREND; MNST (1W: +6.95% | 1M: +4.67%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Broad (5 sectors represented) — healthy dispersion.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: SCHW (1W: -7.71% | 1M: -14.89%) BELOW TREND; C (1W: -7.75% | 1M: -7.65%) BELOW TREND; ETN (1W: -8.25% | 1M: -7.83%) BELOW TREND; INTC (1W: -9.20% | 1M: -15.26%) BELOW TREND; CAT (1W: -9.20% | 1M: -10.28%) BELOW TREND. Weakness concentrated in Financials, Industrials and Semiconductors.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Strongest 1W movers: ACN (1W: +11.15% | 1M: +31.74%) ABOVE TREND, UNH (1W: +7.49% | 1M: +7.95%) ABOVE TREND, LMT (1W: +7.10% | 1M: +2.78%) ABOVE TREND. Note major divergence among large caps: MSFT (1W: -1.41% | 1M: +8.05%) CORRECTION, META (1W: -5.05% | 1M: +6.05%) CORRECTION, TSLA (1W: -2.64% | 1M: +1.04%) CORRECTION — tactical caution advised.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Mixed and under pressure: AAPL (1W: +0.58% | 1M: +2.03%) ABOVE TREND but NVDA (1W: -4.08% | 1M: -2.33%) BELOW TREND, INTC (1W: -9.20% | 1M: -15.26%) BELOW TREND, AMAT (1W: -16.97% | 1M: -7.08%) BELOW TREND. Sector 1W: -3.36% with 24 stocks — internal rotation and concentrated leadership rather than broad tech bid.

8. Financials Outlook?
Mixed; payments and exchanges lead while banks and brokers lag: V (1W: +3.51% | 1M: +9.40%) ABOVE TREND, MA (1W: +3.58% | 1M: +9.22%) ABOVE TREND, CME (1W: +5.88% | 1M: +6.35%) ABOVE TREND versus SCHW (1W: -7.71% | 1M: -14.89%) BELOW TREND and C (1W: -7.75% | 1M: -7.65%) BELOW TREND. Financials 1W: -0.65% (20 stocks) — mixed internal breadth.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Constructive overall: UNH (1W: +7.49% | 1M: +7.95%) ABOVE TREND, LLY (1W: +4.88% | 1M: +7.58%) ABOVE TREND, PFE (1W: +3.66% | 1M: +6.44%) ABOVE TREND while JNJ (1W: -3.77% | 1M: -6.00%) BELOW TREND. Healthcare 1W: +2.50% (17 stocks) — defensive and selective growth coexist.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor exposure to Healthcare and Consumer sectors where breadth and leadership are clear, and monitor select Technology names that remain ABOVE TREND (ACN, AAPL, INTU). Reduce exposure to lagging banks/brokers and semiconductor equipment names showing clear BELOW TREND dynamics (SCHW, C, LRCX, AMAT, INTC).

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: ACN (1W: +11.15% | 1M: +31.74%) ABOVE TREND; UNH (1W: +7.49% | 1M: +7.95%) ABOVE TREND; V (1W: +3.51% | 1M: +9.40%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: AMAT (1W: -16.97% | 1M: -7.08%) BELOW TREND; LRCX (1W: -12.07% | 1M: -5.42%) BELOW TREND; SCHW (1W: -7.71% | 1M: -14.89%) BELOW TREND.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Consumer Staples and Healthcare (both positive breadth). BEARISH: Technology (1W lagging) and Financials (select bank/broker weakness) — overall market remains mixed with 6/11 sectors positive.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Watch NVDA: failure to reclaim recent weekly levels would reinforce BELOW TREND momentum; AAPL: holding 1M trend keeps ABOVE TREND bias; V / MA: sustaining recent breakout would confirm payments leadership; AMAT/LRCX: further weekly weakness would signal extended semiconductor capex slowdown.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
ACN (+55): Accenture AI program headline aligns with price action — ACN (1W: +11.15% | 1M: +31.74%) ABOVE TREND, sentiment confirmed. GE (+85): strong aerospace beat supports industrials — watch for follow-through (industrial cohort mixed). V (+55): partnership/news supports Payments — V (1W: +3.51% | 1M: +9.40%) ABOVE TREND, sentiment confirming.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
LRCX (-45): price confirms sentiment — LRCX (1W: -12.07% | 1M: -5.42%) BELOW TREND. PEP (-55): negative outlook is a divergence versus Consumer Staples strength — PEP (check for relative weakness vs sector). PYPL (-55): downgrade risk amid mixed Financials; monitor for price follow-through.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL, style mixed / no clear leadership. ACN (1W: +11.15% | 1M: +31.74%) ABOVE TREND, UNH (1W: +7.49% | 1M: +7.95%) ABOVE TREND and V (1W: +3.51% | 1M: +9.40%) ABOVE TREND showing relative strength. Major divergence among MSFT, META and TSLA in CORRECTION and semiconductors (AMAT, LRCX, INTC) remain key downside risk, with LRCX negative sentiment confirming pressure.
